section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.3.2) reports results from multilevel analyses examining the relationship between exposure to body-focused and non-body-focused others with dietary restraint, body appreciation, intuitive eating, and body satisfaction. At the between-persons level, greater exposure to non-body-focused others predicted less dietary restraint and greater body appreciation, while exposure to body-focused others predicted greater dietary restraint and less body appreciation. At the within-persons level, daily deviations in exposure to non-body-focused others predicted greater body appreciation and intuitive eating on that day, and preceding increases in such exposure predicted less dietary restraint.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire section 3.3.2 describing results of multilevel models examining exposure to different types of others and eating/body image outcomes.
